Phase 0 retrieval (the code before SB-P2-07) on the grown corpus and golden set (SB-P2-17: 231 queries in 101 clusters, the golden set's own cluster keys). Against the phase 0 lock: INCONCLUSIVE, since the data changed.

SB-P2-07 ranked keyword search (english, any content word, identifier and rarity weights, a stable order for ties) with the retrieval review applied. Gate against the grown-set lock: INCONCLUSIVE in both load modes (169 judged queries in 90 clusters and 7 judged visibility queries, under D-028's floor). For information only: full text judged recall at 5 +0.526 with copies and +0.121 as installed, intervals above 0; as installed no type loses; with copies rare-name MRR -0.031 (q-rare-milers, rank 1 to 2 behind another person's private record that holds both words). No new must-hide reveal.

Golden set and corpus grown for the fixer review of run 2: phase 1 scope cases (a former person, the household's Second Brain workspace, a team workspace, records with no person author) and 41 queries, 272 in all, 207 judged; retrieval code unchanged. Verdict INCONCLUSIVE on every path: the data changed, so nothing is compared with the earlier lock.

SB-P2-08 adds a path, combined (Recall.Search, topK 20, hops 0): ranked full text and passages fused by reciprocal rank (k 60, keyword weight the rarity of the words a row holds, a row without passages given the meaning arm's share at its keyword rank, no diversity step). No tool serves it yet; fulltext, semantic and graph answer exactly as at their last lock. Judged in the same run against each arm alone: against fulltext no type loses in either load mode and overall recall at 5 gains (+0.025 with copies, +0.034 as installed; INCONCLUSIVE only for the household model's reveals, which fulltext shares); against semantic it loses paraphrase, as-of and current, so semantic_search stays a tool of its own.
